question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

They have __disposed__ all the old books.
solution:
The correct answer is: **disposed of **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Disposed of**" means to get rid of or throw away something. (किसी चीज़ से छुटकारा पाना या फेंकना)

 
 
• **For example**: *She quickly disposed of the empty boxes after unpacking her belongings.*
 
 
 
• The correct usage of the phrasal verb is "**disposed of**".
 
• So, In this sentence, "disposed of" is the correct option to substitute the underlined segment "disposed."
 
• It is the appropriate choice to convey the intended meaning of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Corrected sentence**: *They have disposed of all the old books.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**disposed out**" is an incorrect phrasal verb usage.
 
• "**disposed on**" is an incorrect preposition to use with the verb "disposed".
 
• "**disposed by**" is an incorrect passive construction.
